# Comparison task cp86-csv

The authority of checkpoint CP86, a T3.6 L4 comparison task. It is not
a Pactwright specification.

## 1. Behaviour

A CSV line is fields separated by commas. A field may be enclosed in double
quotes; a quoted field may hold commas, and a doubled double quote inside it
stands for one double quote. The enclosing quotes are not part of the field.
